name: Love and Legends
source:
“When worlds collide, do hearts follow?”

You're on your way home from another typical day at your typical techie job in Chicago, when suddenly–you're struck by lightning and wake up in a medieval fantasy world with knights, elves, wizards, and more…?!

When you're accused of being the evil Witch Queen, you're taken into custody by the lord of the land. Now you must choose to tie your fate to one of five heroes straight out of a fairy tale.

Soon enough, it's not just your life on the line - it's your heart.

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/157870524768/love-legends-is-now-available-for-ios-and]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
